card.name: Words in 'tease apart' and 'extent to which'
card.fires_on: The word 'tease' (and the 'apart' after it) in 'tease apart', and 'which' in 'The extent to which'. These appear in research-style sentences about untangling or measuring findings.

modes.label: tease apart
modes.description: The verb 'tease' or the following 'apart' when researchers try to separate causes or traits.
modes.example: In trying to<< tease>> apart the signaling pathway that activates an innate

modes.label: extent to which
modes.description: The word 'which' in the phrase 'The extent to which' that opens a sentence about whether findings apply.
modes.example: The extent to<< which>> the findings of increased mortality in observational studies
